goal: Perform a comprehensive Enterprise Architectural Audit on Deno Edge functions, webhook replay guard, and rate limiting to enforce strict type safety and secure webhook endpoints.
constraints: Strict type safety - zero 'any' or 'as any' casts are allowed.
Enforce mandatory 'x-timestamp' replay guard on webhooks.
Validate rate limit options to prevent division by zero or negative bounds.
known_context: Venthub HVAC portal requires high enterprise-grade security for webhooks and API rate limiting.

risks.description: Rate limiting options are bypassed due to option field naming mismatches.
Webhook endpoints are vulnerable to replay attacks because of optional timestamp verification.

options.title: Strict Deno Edge Function Refactoring
options.reason: Enforces full type safety, adds strict timestamp verification on webhook endpoints, and robust bounds checks on rate limiter inputs.

options.title: Optional Replay Guard with Slack Validation
options.reason: Fails to meet VentHub Enterprise standards and allows potential security bypasses.

recommendation: Option A is highly recommended to align with VentHub HVAC architecture standards and eliminate security vulnerabilities.

traces.finding: Found that returns webhook had an optional timestamp check.
Identified default rate limits lack defensive finite constraints.
